SWITCHING ERP MID-YEAR

How do I switch my jewellery ERP mid-year?

Pick the system you run today. Five steps, done with you, with no big-bang cut-over.

Moving from Tally to Jwero

  1. 1Bring your mastersStock, customers, vendors, karigars and opening balances, exported from Tally with us.
  2. 2Map your way of workingRates, making and wastage rules, branches and approval limits, set the way you run them in Tally today.
  3. 3Run both in parallelBill in Jwero while Tally keeps running, until the daily totals match.
  4. 4Reconcile the cut-overStock, metal and money balances matched on the switch date; differences listed and cleared.
  5. 5Keep Tally, or notYour CA keeps working in Tally, kept in step, or the books move to Jwero’s ledger.

Keep Tally for your CA if you like: Jwero keeps it in step, so the books never have to move.

Jwero and Tally, explained →

QUESTIONS

What people ask before they message.

What is Jwero’s jewellery ERP?

Jwero’s jewellery ERP runs the counter, inventory, manufacturing and karigar job work, purchase, billing and accounts, and repairs on one record, in fine weight with hallmark ID, across every branch. It does what a jewellery ERP is expected to do, and closes the gaps most leave open: wastage settled against your norms, discount approvals, cash variance, stock-to-ledger drift checks and AI that drafts orders and flags problems before they cost you.

What is jewellery ERP software?

Jewellery ERP software runs the whole jewellery business on one system: counter billing at today’s rate, stock by piece and fine weight, purchase, manufacturing and karigar job work, repairs, accounts and GST, on the same records across every branch.

Does Jwero do everything my current ERP does?

Yes for the jewellery basics: tags, weights, hallmark ID, billing, old gold, purchase, job work, khata, GST and ledgers. Jwero then adds what most ERPs leave to people: wastage settled against norms, discount approvals, cash variance, stock-to-ledger drift checks, GSTR-2B matching, AI-drafted orders and a customer record behind every bill.

What leaks does a jewellery ERP usually miss?

Metal lost at the karigar above norm, unapproved discounts, cash short at day close, short deliveries paid in full, missed input credit, repair weight disputes and slow stock valued at old cost. Jwero flags each as it happens.

How does Jwero control gold loss in manufacturing?

Gold is tracked in fine grams through every stage, and every job settles against your wastage norms. Variance shows by job and by karigar over time, and the metal ledger reconciles per karigar.

What does AI do in the ERP?

It drafts purchase orders from what is selling, low and ageing, suggests repricing for slow stock, flags material anomalies, suggests karigar allocation and production schedules, scores vendors and predicts late jobs. Pricing, reminders and checks run on their own; you choose what waits for approval.

Can a jewellery ERP replace Tally?

Jwero keeps its own double-entry ledger with GST, P&L and balance sheet, so many shops run their books in Jwero. Others keep Tally or Zoho Books for their CA, and Jwero keeps it in step so nothing is typed twice.

Does the counter work without internet?

Yes. The till keeps billing through a dropout, and each sale syncs once the connection returns, without duplicates.

Does it check hallmark ID before a sale?

Yes. The counter checks each piece’s hallmark ID and can warn or block an unhallmarked sale, your choice. Duplicate HUIDs are refused at stock entry.

Can I buy gold before the rate is fixed?

Yes. Record an unfixed-rate purchase by weight and purity and fix the rate later. The bill and the metal ledger update when it is fixed.

How are repairs tracked?

A job slip with photos and weight-in, an estimate she approves, every handoff logged, weight-out compared, a re-hallmark flag where needed, and ready notices to the customer.

Does it work for many branches?

Yes. Stock, transfers, branch policies and reports by branch, with consolidation for the group and franchise screens.

Does it use RFID?

Jwero is RFID-ready: RFID scans move tags the same way barcode scans do. Barcode labels are printed from each piece’s record.

How do I switch ERP mid-year?

Import your masters and opening balances, run Jwero alongside the old system until totals match, reconcile stock, metal and money on the switch date, then switch off the old system. We do it with you.

What happened to the separate Inventory, POS, Manufacturing, Purchase, Billing and Repairs pages?

They are now one page, because they are one system. Each has its own section here and a short guide for its search.
